author: IGN
description:
Join the developers of Above: Colonies of the Mist for a deep dive into the gameplay and more from this upcoming vertical colony sim game. Learn about challenges you'll face and strategies you'll need to survive. Above: Colonies of the Mist will be available on PC. Sign-ups for a playtest are available via Steam.

In Above: Colonies of the Mist, build a hilltop colony in the last land safe from the toxic mist. Survive, expand, explore ancient monuments, and look for a way out before the mist claims everything.
title: Above: Colonies of the Mist - Official Dev Commentary Trailer

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Hordeguard: Winds of the North, a tower-defense strategy action RPG developed by Black Deer Games. Players will defend a Viking settlement from relentless incoming hordes. Gather resources, explore a sprawling world, and head into battle alone or with friends in co-op. Hordeguard: Winds of the North is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Hordeguard: Winds of the North - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out this new gameplay trailer for Stormforge, which might most generously be described as a bit of Valheim and a bit of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. Stormforge is a fantasy open-world survival crafting game for up to eight players. Check it out, and wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826790/Stormforge/

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Chapter 7 Season 4 release date trailer for Fortnite, the latest season for the hit free-to-play battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. The mission is simple - override the system, take back the Island, and stop Geno before it’s GAME OVER. Chapter 7 Season 4 for Fortnite: Override is launching on August 20 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, iOS, Android, and PC (Epic Games Store, GeForce Now, Amazon Luna).

#ign #gaming
title: Fortnite - Official Chapter 7 Season 4: Override Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Get a look at the demo launch trailer for No Visitors Allowed, a psychological anomaly-horror game set inside a looping abandoned post-Soviet hospital developed by Shak. Players must carefully observe each floor, identify anomalies, and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. No Visitors Allowed is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

#ign #gaming
title: No Visitors Allowed - Official Demo Launch Trailer
